about: What a response (record.discussion[].stance) does to the record, set by a person with index.py discuss --stance. Read by index.py, lib/view.ts (the record page and the API docs) and lib/query.ts (the popularity sorts). upvoting stances count like an upvote, and so does a link with no stance yet when unlabelled_upvotes is true; a disputing one marks the record disputed (is:disputed). supabase/migrations/20261026000000_stance.sql and stance-prompt.md cannot read this file: test_index.py checks they list the same stances.

stances.refutes: finds an error that breaks the main result
stances.questions: a gap, a Lean/prose mismatch, a weaker statement than claimed, or priority
